title: In The End I Only Think Of You
genre: Post Wave / Post Punk / Dark Wave
text_de: „In The End I Only Think Of You" ist ihre neue Single — und sie trifft einen sehr spezifischen Schwindel: den freien Fall nach dem Ende einer Beziehung. Nicht die Entscheidung. Nicht den Streit. Das Danach — diesen gedehnten, bodenlosen Moment, in dem man weiß, dass es richtig war loszulassen, und trotzdem kehren die Gedanken immer wieder zu ihr zurück. Jedes Mal. Ohne Ausnahme.

Der Titel ist gleichzeitig Geständnis und Widerspruch. Am Ende, nach allem Kämpfen und Vortäuschen und Festhalten, landet der Gedanke immer am selben Ort. Nicht weil die Liebe sich nicht verändert hätte — sie hat. „I will love you endlessly / But not like that again." Aber eine Liebe, die ihre Form gewechselt hat, weiß nicht immer, wo sie landen soll.

Der Song bewegt sich zwischen Freiem Fall und Zärtlichkeit, zwischen „let's pretend it's all alright" und „when you call me late at night / I will listen every time." Es ist das Porträt von jemandem, der das Richtige getan hat — und trotzdem dafür zahlt. Auf die menschlichste Art, die es gibt.

Produziert mit Leon Kaack, markiert der Sound eine Entwicklung für SOFTBLECH: weniger Dark Wave, mehr Post Punk — roher, direkter, mit einer Songstruktur, die ihre eigenen Regeln bricht. Ein neuer Sound — aber unverkennbar sie.
text_en: "In The End I Only Think Of You" is their new single — and it captures a very specific kind of vertigo: the freefall that comes after a relationship ends. Not the decision. Not the fight. The aftermath — that stretched-out, groundless moment where you know it was right to let go, and yet your mind keeps returning to her. Every time. Without fail.

The title is both confession and contradiction. In the end, after all the trying and pretending and holding on, thought always arrives at the same place. Not because the love hasn't changed — it has. "I will love you endlessly / But not like that again." But love that changes form doesn't always know where to land.

The song moves between freefall and tenderness, between "let's pretend it's all alright" and "when you call me late at night / I will listen every time." It's the portrait of someone who has done the right thing, and is still paying for it — in the most human way possible.

Produced with Leon Kaack, the sound marks a shift for SOFTBLECH: less dark wave, more post punk — rawer, more direct, with a song structure that breaks its own rules. A new sound, but unmistakably them.
lyrics:
Verse 1
Somehow it feels like I'm falling from the sky
I might die but you're always on my mind
Falling down, need you in my arms
Falling down for what I've done

So let's pretend it's all alright, alright, alright
Let's just not cry, not cry, not cry tonight
I still try to hold you close
I should let you go
But I can't and you know

Verse 2
One day when the feeling fades away
I still hope that you'll feel the same someday
You've always meant the world to me
And I know I will love you endlessly

But not like that, like that, like that again
When you call me late at night
I will listen every time
'Cause in the end I will only think of you

Chorus
In the end I only think of you
It's hard to see it through
The shadows in my mind subside
And I'll try to fly on my own

pitch_en: "In The End I Only Think Of You" is about the freefall after a breakup: you know letting go was right, and still every thought ends up with her. Rawer and more direct than before, with a song structure that breaks its own rules. Produced by Leon Kaack.
quote_short_en: In the end, we only think of you. That's not a love song. That's just the truth.
